-- Backward-compatible expansion only. The internal-column contract is deferred.
set local lock_timeout = '10s';
create temporary table pricing_rollout_before on commit drop as
select (select md5(string_agg(row(id,price_paisa,sale_price_paisa,version,publication_status)::text,'|' order by id)) from public.products) as products,
       (select md5(string_agg(row(id,stock,reserved,inventory_version)::text,'|' order by id)) from public.product_variants) as inventory,

-- Source: 20261116120000_product_writes_through_functions_only.sql
-- Product and photo writes only through the admin functions.
--
-- 20261029120000_admin_product_management.sql gave verified admins column
-- grants on products and product_images, and the admin functions ran as
-- SECURITY INVOKER on top of them. 20261031120000_inventory_ledger.sql made
-- admin_create_product and admin_save_product SECURITY DEFINER, but the
-- grants stayed, so a verified admin's session token could still skip the
-- functions over the REST API: change a published price or name without the
-- version check, archive or back-date a listing, insert products, or delete
-- photo rows (leaving their Storage objects behind).
--
-- 1. The two remaining invoker functions become SECURITY DEFINER, like the
--    other admin product functions. Nothing else about them changes: each
--    still calls admin_require_catalogue_admin() first (the same check the
--    RLS policies made), locks the product and checks its version, and keeps
--    search_path = ''. Their EXECUTE grants are unchanged.
-- 2. Verified admins lose direct INSERT/UPDATE on products and
--    INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on product_images. As for product_variants in
--    20261031120000, revoking the table privilege also revokes the column
--    grants. SELECT (the admin screens' reads, still limited by RLS) and
--    anon's access are unchanged. No rows, versions, stock or photos change.

alter function public.admin_add_product_image(uuid, integer, uuid, text, integer, integer, text) security definer;
alter function public.admin_set_publication_status(uuid, integer, text) security definer;

revoke insert, update on table public.products from authenticated;
revoke insert, update, delete on table public.product_images from authenticated;

-- Source: 20261118120000_sales_agents.sql
-- Sales agents: accounts, referral codes and their current terms.
--
-- An agent is a Supabase Auth user that a verified admin has set up, plus a
-- row here. The row is what grants the /agent area; signing in alone grants
-- nothing (public sign-up stays disabled in the Auth settings).
--
-- Referral codes (README, "Sales agents"):
--   * letters A-Z and digits 0-9 only, 3 to 16 characters;
--   * case-insensitive: stored upper-case; spaces and hyphens typed by a
--     customer or admin are ignored (private.normalize_referral_code, and the
--     same rule in lib/agents/code.ts);
--   * one per agent, unique across every agent ever created (a unique
--     constraint, so two simultaneous creations can't both get one);
--   * never changed and never released: agents are never deleted, and the
--     code column is fixed by a trigger, so a deactivated agent's code stays
--     reserved and history keeps pointing at the right person.
--
-- Terms (current configuration; every order keeps its own snapshot, see
-- 20261118120100_referral_checkout.sql):
--   * discount_bp      customer discount in basis points (1000 = 10%), 0-50%
--   * commission_bp    agent commission in basis points, 0-50%; required
--                      before the code can be enabled
--   * applies_to_sale_items  whether the discount (and so commission) applies
--                      to products already on sale; must be chosen explicitly
--                      (null until then) before the code can be enabled
--   * code_enabled     whether checkout accepts the code for new orders
--   * access_status    pending (no Auth user linked yet), active, suspended
--                      (can't use /agent; earnings and history are kept)
--
-- Access: RLS on, no table privileges for any API role. Admins (member +
-- aal2) use the admin_* functions below; agents use the agent_* functions in
-- 20261118120200_commission_accounting.sql, which return only their own data.
--
-- Locking: an agent row is locked FOR NO KEY UPDATE by admin changes, FOR
-- SHARE by order placement (its terms can't change mid-order) and FOR NO KEY
-- UPDATE by payouts. Nothing locks an agent row while holding an order lock.
--
-- Retries (every admin change carries a request id made by the form):
--   * The request's identity is its operation and its full, normalised
--     payload (and, for edits, the version the admin saw), kept as a SHA-256
--     fingerprint on the record it created: sales_agents.created_request_fingerprint
--     for a creation, sales_agent_events.request_fingerprint for an edit.
--   * The same request id with the same identity is a replay: nothing is
--     applied again, and the answer is the ORIGINAL result (for an edit, the
--     version that edit produced, never a newer one made by someone else).
--   * The same request id with anything different (another payload, another
--     action) is refused: PT409, hint request_mismatch.
--   * Creation is serialised per request id and per email (transaction
--     advisory locks taken before anything is read), so two identical
--     requests sent at once get the same agent, and two different requests
--     for the same email or code still conflict.

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Tables
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

create table public.sales_agents (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  -- Restrict: an Auth user who is (or was) an agent can't be deleted; suspend
  -- the agent instead, so earnings and payout history keep their owner.
  user_id uuid references auth.users (id) on delete restrict,
  username text not null,
  display_name text not null,
  -- The email the account was set up with (lower-case). Used only to find
  -- the Auth user when linking; never shown outside the admin area.
  email text not null,
  code text not null,
  access_status text not null default 'pending',
  code_enabled boolean not null default false,
  discount_bp integer not null,
  commission_bp integer,
  applies_to_sale_items boolean,
  -- +1 whenever discount, commission or sale-item eligibility changes.
  terms_version integer not null default 1,
  -- +1 on every change (optimistic concurrency for admin forms).
  version integer not null default 1,
  created_request_id uuid not null,
  -- SHA-256 of the creation request's normalised payload (its retry identity).
  created_request_fingerprint bytea not null,
  created_by uuid,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),

  constraint sales_agents_user_key unique (user_id),
  constraint sales_agents_username_key unique (username),
  constraint sales_agents_email_key unique (email),
  constraint sales_agents_code_key unique (code),
  constraint sales_agents_request_key unique (created_request_id),
  constraint sales_agents_username_format check (username ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{2,29}$'),
  constraint sales_agents_code_format check (code ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{3,16}$'),
  constraint sales_agents_display_name_valid check (
    char_length(display_name) between 2 and 80 and display_name = btrim(display_name) and display_name !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'),
  constraint sales_agents_email_valid check (
    email = lower(email) and char_length(email) between 3 and 254 and email ~ '^[^@[:space:]]+@[^@[:space:]]+$'),
  constraint sales_agents_access_valid check (access_status in ('pending', 'active', 'suspended')),
  constraint sales_agents_pending_iff_unlinked check ((access_status = 'pending') = (user_id is null)),
  constraint sales_agents_discount_range check (discount_bp between 0 and 5000),
  constraint sales_agents_commission_range check (commission_bp is null or commission_bp between 0 and 5000),
  constraint sales_agents_enabled_needs_terms check (
    not code_enabled or (commission_bp is not null and applies_to_sale_items is not null)),
  constraint sales_agents_versions_positive check (version > 0 and terms_version > 0),
  constraint sales_agents_fingerprint_length check (octet_length(created_request_fingerprint) = 32)
);

comment on table public.sales_agents is
  'Sales agents: login link, referral code (fixed, never reused) and CURRENT terms. Orders keep their own snapshot.';

-- Who changed what, and when. Append-only.
create table public.sales_agent_events (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  agent_id uuid not null references public.sales_agents (id) on delete restrict,
  kind text not null,
  details jsonb,
  actor_user_id uuid,
  -- An admin edit's request id, its identity (operation and payload, as a
  -- SHA-256) and the agent version it produced: a retry with the same
  -- identity gets that version back; anything else is refused.
  request_id uuid,
  operation text,
  request_fingerprint bytea,
  result_version integer,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),

  constraint sales_agent_events_request_key unique (agent_id, request_id),
  constraint sales_agent_events_request_complete check (
    request_id is null or (operation is not null and octet_length(request_fingerprint) = 32 and result_version > 0)),
  constraint sales_agent_events_kind_valid check (kind in (
    'created', 'linked', 'profile_changed', 'terms_changed', 'code_enabled', 'code_disabled',
    'suspended', 'reactivated', 'invite_link_created'))
);

create index sales_agent_events_agent_idx on public.sales_agent_events (agent_id, id);

create trigger sales_agent_events_append_only before update or delete on public.sales_agent_events
  for each row execute function private.append_only();
create trigger sales_agent_events_no_truncate before truncate on public.sales_agent_events
  for each statement execute function private.append_only();

-- Fixed facts of an agent; never deleted.
create function private.sales_agents_guard()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if tg_op = 'DELETE' then
    raise exception 'Sales agents are never deleted; suspend them instead.' using errcode = 'PT400', hint = 'append_only';
  end if;
  if (new.id, new.code, new.email, new.created_request_id, new.created_request_fingerprint, new.created_by, new.created_at)
     is distinct from (old.id, old.code, old.email, old.created_request_id, old.created_request_fingerprint, old.created_by, old.created_at) then
    raise exception 'An agent''s referral code, email and creation record never change.' using errcode = 'PT400', hint = 'agent_locked';
  end if;
  if old.user_id is not null and new.user_id is distinct from old.user_id then
    raise exception 'An agent''s login can''t be moved to another account.' using errcode = 'PT400', hint = 'agent_locked';
  end if;
  if (new.discount_bp, new.commission_bp, new.applies_to_sale_items)
     is distinct from (old.discount_bp, old.commission_bp, old.applies_to_sale_items) then
    new.terms_version := old.terms_version + 1;
  else
    new.terms_version := old.terms_version;
  end if;
  new.version := old.version + 1;
  new.updated_at := now();
  return new;
end;
$$;

create trigger sales_agents_guard before update or delete on public.sales_agents
  for each row execute function private.sales_agents_guard();
create trigger sales_agents_no_truncate before truncate on public.sales_agents
  for each statement execute function private.append_only();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Helpers
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- The one normalisation rule for referral codes (also lib/agents/code.ts):
-- remove whitespace and hyphens, then upper-case. Doesn't validate.
create function private.normalize_referral_code(p_code text)
returns text
language sql
immutable
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select nullif(upper(regexp_replace(coalesce(p_code, ''), '[[:space:]-]+', '', 'g')), '');
$$;

create function private.is_referral_code(p_code text)
returns boolean
language sql
immutable
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select coalesce(p_code ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{3,16}$', false);
$$;

-- Admin-facing view of an agent (never returned to agents or shoppers).
create function private.agent_admin_view(p_agent_id uuid)
returns jsonb
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'id', a.id, 'user_id', a.user_id, 'username', a.username, 'display_name', a.display_name, 'email', a.email,
    'code', a.code, 'access_status', a.access_status, 'code_enabled', a.code_enabled,
    'discount_bp', a.discount_bp, 'commission_bp', a.commission_bp, 'applies_to_sale_items', a.applies_to_sale_items,
    'terms_version', a.terms_version, 'version', a.version, 'created_at', a.created_at, 'updated_at', a.updated_at)
  from public.sales_agents a where a.id = p_agent_id;
$$;

-- Validated terms from a request: {discount_bp, commission_bp, applies_to_sale_items}.
create function private.agent_terms_input(p_terms jsonb)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
immutable
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  discount text := p_terms ->> 'discount_bp';
  commission text := p_terms ->> 'commission_bp';
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(p_terms) is distinct from 'object'
    or discount is null or discount !~ '^[0-9]{1,5}$' or discount::integer > 5000
    or (commission is not null and (commission !~ '^[0-9]{1,5}$' or commission::integer > 5000))
    or (p_terms ? 'applies_to_sale_items' and jsonb_typeof(p_terms -> 'applies_to_sale_items') not in ('boolean', 'null')) then
    raise exception 'Discount and commission are percentages from 0 to 50.' using errcode = 'PT400', hint = 'invalid_terms';
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'discount_bp', discount::integer,
    'commission_bp', commission::integer,
    'applies_to_sale_items', case when jsonb_typeof(p_terms -> 'applies_to_sale_items') = 'boolean'
                                  then (p_terms ->> 'applies_to_sale_items')::boolean end);
end;
$$;

-- The identity of an admin request: operation, target, the version the admin
-- saw (edits) and the normalised payload.
create function private.agent_request_fingerprint(p_operation text, p_agent_id uuid, p_expected_version integer, p_payload jsonb)
returns bytea
language sql
immutable
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_object('operation', p_operation, 'agent', p_agent_id,
    'expected_version', p_expected_version, 'payload', p_payload)::text, 'UTF8'));
$$;

-- Locks an agent for an admin edit and checks the request:
--   * null: this request was already applied with the same identity (a
--     retry); the caller answers with private.agent_replay();
--   * the same request id with a different identity: refused (request_mismatch);
--   * otherwise the version the admin saw must be the current one.
create function private.agent_admin_lock(
  p_agent_id uuid, p_expected_version integer, p_request_id uuid, p_operation text, p_payload jsonb
)
returns public.sales_agents
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  agent public.sales_agents;
  earlier public.sales_agent_events;
begin
  perform public.admin_require_catalogue_admin();
  if p_agent_id is null or p_request_id is null then
    raise exception 'Malformed request.' using errcode = 'PT400';
  end if;
  -- The lock first: the same request still running elsewhere holds it.
  select * into agent from public.sales_agents where id = p_agent_id for no key update;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'Agent not found.' using errcode = 'PT404';
  end if;
  select * into earlier from public.sales_agent_events e where e.agent_id = p_agent_id and e.request_id = p_request_id;
  if found then
    if earlier.request_fingerprint = private.agent_request_fingerprint(p_operation, p_agent_id, p_expected_version, p_payload) then
      return null;
    end if;
    raise exception 'This form was already used for a different change. Reload the page.'
      using errcode = 'PT409', hint = 'request_mismatch';
  end if;
  if p_expected_version is distinct from agent.version then
    raise exception 'This agent was changed somewhere else since you opened it.' using errcode = 'PT409', hint = 'version_conflict';
  end if;
  return agent;
end;
$$;

-- A retry's answer: the version the original request produced (not the
-- current one, which someone else may have changed since).
create function private.agent_replay(p_agent_id uuid, p_request_id uuid)
returns jsonb
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select jsonb_build_object('result', 'replayed', 'id', e.agent_id, 'version', e.result_version)
  from public.sales_agent_events e where e.agent_id = p_agent_id and e.request_id = p_request_id;
$$;

-- Records an applied edit (with its identity and resulting version) and answers.
create function private.agent_edit_done(
  p_agent_id uuid, p_request_id uuid, p_operation text, p_expected_version integer, p_payload jsonb,
  p_kind text, p_details jsonb
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  new_version integer := (select a.version from public.sales_agents a where a.id = p_agent_id);
begin
  insert into public.sales_agent_events (agent_id, kind, details, actor_user_id, request_id, operation, request_fingerprint, result_version)
  values (p_agent_id, p_kind, p_details, (select auth.uid()), p_request_id, p_operation,
    private.agent_request_fingerprint(p_operation, p_agent_id, p_expected_version, p_payload), new_version);
  return jsonb_build_object('result', 'done', 'id', p_agent_id, 'version', new_version, 'agent', private.agent_admin_view(p_agent_id));
end;
$$;

create function private.agent_result(p_agent_id uuid, p_result text)
returns jsonb
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select jsonb_build_object('result', p_result, 'agent', private.agent_admin_view(p_agent_id));
$$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Admin functions (authenticated; each refuses anyone but a verified admin)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- For the creation form: is this code well-formed and still free? Admins only;
-- says nothing about who holds a taken code.
create function public.admin_check_agent_code(p_code text)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_code text := private.normalize_referral_code(p_code);
begin
  perform public.admin_require_catalogue_admin();
  if char_length(coalesce(p_code, '')) > 64 then
    return jsonb_build_object('code', null, 'valid', false, 'available', false);
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'code', v_code,
    'valid', private.is_referral_code(v_code),
    'available', private.is_referral_code(v_code) and not exists (select 1 from public.sales_agents a where a.code = v_code));
end;
$$;

-- Creates an agent (no login yet: access_status pending). Safe to retry with
-- the same request id. p_agent: {username, display_name, email, code,
-- discount_bp, commission_bp, applies_to_sale_items, code_enabled}.
-- Results: created | existing (same request id, same payload: the agent it
-- created) | email_exists (another request already created an agent with
-- this email; its id is returned so the admin can open it) | username_taken
-- | code_taken. The same request id with a different payload is refused
-- (PT409, request_mismatch).
create function public.admin_create_agent(p_request_id uuid, p_agent jsonb)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
set lock_timeout = '5s'
as $$
declare
  v_username text := lower(btrim(coalesce(p_agent ->> 'username', '')));
  v_display_name text := regexp_replace(btrim(coalesce(p_agent ->> 'display_name', '')), '\s+', ' ', 'g');
  v_email text := lower(btrim(coalesce(p_agent ->> 'email', '')));
  v_code text := private.normalize_referral_code(p_agent ->> 'code');
  v_terms jsonb := private.agent_terms_input(p_agent);
  v_enabled boolean := coalesce((p_agent ->> 'code_enabled')::boolean, false);
  v_fingerprint bytea;
  existing public.sales_agents;
  new_id uuid;
  v_constraint text;
begin
  perform public.admin_require_catalogue_admin();
  if p_request_id is null or jsonb_typeof(p_agent) is distinct from 'object' then
    raise exception 'Malformed request.' using errcode = 'PT400';
  end if;
  if v_username !~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{2,29}$' then
    raise exception 'Usernames are 3-30 lower-case letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores.'
      using errcode = 'PT400', hint = 'invalid_username';
  end if;
  if char_length(v_display_name) not between 2 and 80 or v_display_name ~ '[[:cntrl:]]' then
    raise exception 'Enter a display name (2-80 characters).' using errcode = 'PT400', hint = 'invalid_display_name';
  end if;
  if char_length(v_email) not between 3 and 254 or v_email !~ '^[^@[:space:]]+@[^@[:space:]]+\.[^@[:space:]]+$' then
    raise exception 'Enter a valid email address.' using errcode = 'PT400', hint = 'invalid_email';
  end if;
  if not private.is_referral_code(v_code) then
    raise exception 'Codes are 3-16 letters and digits.' using errcode = 'PT400', hint = 'invalid_code';
  end if;
  if v_enabled and ((v_terms ->> 'commission_bp') is null or (v_terms ->> 'applies_to_sale_items') is null) then
    raise exception 'Set the commission and choose whether sale items qualify before enabling the code.'
      using errcode = 'PT400', hint = 'terms_required';
  end if;
  -- The request's identity: everything it asked for, normalised.
  v_fingerprint := private.agent_request_fingerprint('create', null, null, jsonb_build_object(
    'username', v_username, 'display_name', v_display_name, 'email', v_email, 'code', v_code,
    'discount_bp', (v_terms ->> 'discount_bp')::integer, 'commission_bp', (v_terms ->> 'commission_bp')::integer,
    'applies_to_sale_items', (v_terms ->> 'applies_to_sale_items')::boolean, 'code_enabled', v_enabled));

  -- Serialise: one creation per request id at a time, then per email, BEFORE
  -- reading anything. A copy of this request still running elsewhere is
  -- waited for, so its agent is found below (and never reported as
  -- "email_exists"); another request for the same email waits too and then
  -- sees the email taken.
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('sales_agent_request:' || p_request_id::text, 20261118));
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('sales_agent_email:' || v_email, 20261118));

  select * into existing from public.sales_agents a where a.created_request_id = p_request_id;
  if found then
    if existing.created_request_fingerprint = v_fingerprint then
      return private.agent_result(existing.id, 'existing');
    end if;
    raise exception 'This form was already used for a different agent. Reload the page.'
      using errcode = 'PT409', hint = 'request_mismatch';
  end if;
  select * into existing from public.sales_agents a where a.email = v_email;
  if found then
    return jsonb_build_object('result', 'email_exists', 'agent_id', existing.id);
  end if;

  begin
    insert into public.sales_agents (username, display_name, email, code, code_enabled, discount_bp, commission_bp,
      applies_to_sale_items, created_request_id, created_request_fingerprint, created_by)
    values (v_username, v_display_name, v_email, v_code, v_enabled, (v_terms ->> 'discount_bp')::integer,
      (v_terms ->> 'commission_bp')::integer, (v_terms ->> 'applies_to_sale_items')::boolean, p_request_id, v_fingerprint,
      (select auth.uid()))
    returning id into new_id;
  exception when unique_violation then
    -- Another request (not this one: that is serialised above) took the code or username.
    get stacked diagnostics v_constraint = constraint_name;
    return jsonb_build_object('result', case v_constraint
      when 'sales_agents_code_key' then 'code_taken'
      when 'sales_agents_username_key' then 'username_taken'
      else 'email_exists' end);
  end;

  insert into public.sales_agent_events (agent_id, kind, details, actor_user_id, request_id, operation, request_fingerprint, result_version)
  values (new_id, 'created', private.agent_admin_view(new_id) - 'user_id', (select auth.uid()), p_request_id, 'create', v_fingerprint, 1);
  return private.agent_result(new_id, 'created');
end;
$$;

-- Links the agent to the Auth user with the agent's email (created by the
-- website's invitation step with the Auth admin API). Safe to repeat.
-- Results: linked | already_linked | no_auth_user (no Auth user with that
-- email yet) | is_admin (admins can't also be agents) | linked_elsewhere.
create function public.admin_link_agent_user(p_agent_id uuid)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
set lock_timeout = '2s'
as $$
declare
  agent public.sales_agents;
  found_user uuid;
  user_count integer;
begin
  perform public.admin_require_catalogue_admin();
  select * into agent from public.sales_agents where id = p_agent_id for no key update;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'Agent not found.' using errcode = 'PT404';
  end if;
  if agent.user_id is not null then
    return private.agent_result(agent.id, 'already_linked');
  end if;
  select count(*), min(u.id::text)::uuid into user_count, found_user from auth.users u where lower(u.email) = agent.email;
  if user_count = 0 then
    return jsonb_build_object('result', 'no_auth_user');
  end if;
  if user_count > 1 then
    raise exception 'More than one login has this email.' using errcode = 'PT409', hint = 'ambiguous_user';
  end if;
  if exists (select 1 from public.admin_members m where m.user_id = found_user) then
    return jsonb_build_object('result', 'is_admin');
  end if;
  if exists (select 1 from public.sales_agents a where a.user_id = found_user) then
    return jsonb_build_object('result', 'linked_elsewhere');
  end if;

-- Source: 20261118120100_referral_checkout.sql
-- Referral codes at checkout: the customer discount, and an immutable
-- snapshot of the referral and its commission on every order that used one.
--
-- Builds on 20261118120000_sales_agents.sql and the checkout functions as
-- last changed in 20261117120100_checkout_quota_quotes_and_phone_limit.sql.
--
-- Business rules (README, "Sales agents"):
--   * One code per order. A line qualifies unless its product is on sale and
--     the agent's terms say sale items don't qualify. Lines that don't
--     qualify pay their normal (sale) price and earn no commission.
--   * Discount = discount % of the qualifying lines' total.
--     Commission = commission % of (qualifying total - discount). Delivery
--     never earns commission.
--   * Rounding (the only rule): each amount is calculated once per order in
--     whole paisa, rounded half up (private.percent_of), then shared across
--     the qualifying lines in proportion to their amounts, the leftover paisa
--     going to the lines with the largest remainders, earlier lines first on
--     a tie (private.allocate_paisa). Line shares always add up exactly.
--   * Free delivery is judged on the merchandise total AFTER the discount.
--   * The database works out every amount. The website sends only the code
--     and the discount the customer saw; any difference returns
--     quote_changed with the new quote, never an order.
--   * The order keeps a snapshot: agent, code, terms, qualifying amounts,
--     per-line discount and commission, and the commission hold policy.
--     Later changes to the agent or their terms affect new orders only.
--   * Commission is never part of a shopper-facing response.
--
-- Compatibility: an order without a code is normalised exactly as before
-- (no new keys), so its fingerprint, retries and checkout_resolve answers
-- are unchanged, and the previous website keeps working until it is
-- replaced (quote_order keeps working with three arguments).
--
-- Locking order (extends 20261117120100): 1. key, 1a. phone, 2. settings,
-- 2a. the code's agent row (FOR SHARE: its terms can't change until the
-- order commits), 3. orders, 4. products, 5. sizes, 6. global quota.

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Orders: the discount
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

alter table public.orders add column discount_paisa bigint not null default 0;

comment on column public.orders.discount_paisa is
  'Referral discount on the merchandise (0 without a code). total = subtotal - discount + delivery.';

alter table public.orders drop constraint orders_amounts_valid;
alter table public.orders add constraint orders_amounts_valid check (
  subtotal_paisa >= 0 and delivery_paisa >= 0 and discount_paisa between 0 and subtotal_paisa
  and total_paisa = subtotal_paisa - discount_paisa + delivery_paisa
  and (collected_paisa is null or collected_paisa between 0 and total_paisa)
  and (refunded_paisa is null or (collected_paisa is not null and refunded_paisa between 1 and collected_paisa))
);

-- As in 20261031130000_guest_orders.sql, plus: the discount is fixed like
-- the other totals, and the delivery time, once recorded, never changes (the
-- commission hold counts from it; a replayed or repeated delivery event can't
-- restart or shorten it).
create or replace function private.orders_guard()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if tg_op = 'DELETE' then
    raise exception 'Orders are never deleted.' using errcode = 'PT400', hint = 'append_only';
  end if;
  if (new.id, new.order_number, new.channel, new.request_key_hash, new.request_fingerprint,
      new.subtotal_paisa, new.discount_paisa, new.delivery_paisa, new.total_paisa, new.created_at)
     is distinct from
     (old.id, old.order_number, old.channel, old.request_key_hash, old.request_fingerprint,
      old.subtotal_paisa, old.discount_paisa, old.delivery_paisa, old.total_paisa, old.created_at) then
    raise exception 'An order''s number, contents and totals never change.' using errcode = 'PT400', hint = 'order_locked';
  end if;
  if old.delivered_at is not null and new.delivered_at is distinct from old.delivered_at then
    raise exception 'An order''s delivery time never changes once recorded.' using errcode = 'PT400', hint = 'order_locked';
  end if;
  if new.status is distinct from old.status and (old.status, new.status) not in (
    ('awaiting_confirmation', 'confirmed'), ('awaiting_confirmation', 'cancelled'),
    ('confirmed', 'dispatched'), ('confirmed', 'cancelled'),
    ('dispatched', 'delivered'), ('dispatched', 'delivery_failed'),
    ('delivery_failed', 'dispatched'), ('delivery_failed', 'delivered'), ('delivery_failed', 'returned'),
    ('delivered', 'returned')
  ) then
    raise exception 'An order can''t go from % to %.', old.status, new.status using errcode = 'PT409', hint = 'bad_transition';
  end if;
  if new.payment_status is distinct from old.payment_status and (old.payment_status, new.payment_status) not in (
    ('pending', 'collected'), ('pending', 'void'), ('collected', 'settled'),
    ('collected', 'refund_due'), ('settled', 'refund_due'), ('refund_due', 'refunded')
  ) then
    raise exception 'Payment can''t go from % to %.', old.payment_status, new.payment_status
      using errcode = 'PT409', hint = 'bad_payment_transition';
  end if;
  new.version := old.version + 1;
  new.updated_at := now();
  return new;
end;
$$;

-- Money helpers
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- p_bp basis points (1/100 of a percent) of p_amount paisa, rounded half up
-- to a whole paisa. Exact: numeric arithmetic, no floating point.
create function private.percent_of(p_amount bigint, p_bp integer)
returns bigint
language sql
immutable
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select floor((p_amount::numeric * p_bp + 5000) / 10000)::bigint;
$$;

-- Shares p_total paisa across lines in proportion to p_weights: whole paisa,
-- the leftover going to the largest remainders (earlier lines first on a
-- tie). The shares add up to p_total exactly. Zero weights get nothing.
create function private.allocate_paisa(p_total bigint, p_weights bigint[])
returns bigint[]
language plpgsql
immutable
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  weight_sum numeric;
  shares bigint[];
begin
  select coalesce(sum(w), 0) into weight_sum from unnest(p_weights) w;
  if cardinality(p_weights) = 0 then
    return '{}';
  end if;
  if weight_sum = 0 or p_total = 0 then
    return array_fill(0::bigint, array[cardinality(p_weights)]);
  end if;
  with parts as (
    select i, floor(p_total::numeric * w / weight_sum)::bigint as base, (p_total::numeric * w) % weight_sum as remainder
    from unnest(p_weights) with ordinality as u (w, i)
  ),
  leftover as (
    select p_total - sum(base) as paisa from parts
  ),
  ranked as (
    select i, base, row_number() over (order by remainder desc, i) as rank from parts
  )
  select array_agg(r.base + case when r.rank <= l.paisa then 1 else 0 end order by r.i)
  into shares
  from ranked r cross join leftover l;
  return shares;
end;
$$;

as $$

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Checkout input: the referral code and the discount the customer saw
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- As in 20261031130000_guest_orders.sql, plus two optional fields:
--   "referral_code"  any text; normalised (private.normalize_referral_code)
--   "discount_paisa" the discount the customer saw (only with a code)
-- Without a code the result is exactly what it was before this migration.
create or replace function private.checkout_input(p_order jsonb)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
immutable
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  lines jsonb;
  customer jsonb := p_order -> 'customer';
  referral_code text;
  discount bigint;
  result jsonb;
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(p_order) is distinct from 'object' or jsonb_typeof(p_order -> 'lines') is distinct from 'array'
    or jsonb_typeof(customer) is distinct from 'object'
    or jsonb_array_length(p_order -> 'lines') not between 1 and 50
    or jsonb_typeof(p_order -> 'delivery_paisa') is distinct from 'number'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_order -> 'total_paisa') is distinct from 'number' then
    raise exception 'Malformed order.' using errcode = 'PT400', hint = 'invalid_order', detail = 'order';
  end if;
  if exists (
    select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_order -> 'lines') l
    where jsonb_typeof(l -> 'sku') is distinct from 'string'
      or char_length(l ->> 'sku') not between 1 and 64
      or jsonb_typeof(l -> 'quantity') is distinct from 'number'
      or (l ->> 'quantity') !~ '^[0-9]{1,4}$' or (l ->> 'quantity')::integer < 1
      or jsonb_typeof(l -> 'unit_price_paisa') is distinct from 'number'
      or (l ->> 'unit_price_paisa') !~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$'
  ) or (select count(distinct l ->> 'sku') from jsonb_array_elements(p_order -> 'lines') l) <> jsonb_array_length(p_order -> 'lines')
    or (p_order ->> 'delivery_paisa') !~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' or (p_order ->> 'total_paisa') !~ '^[0-9]{1,12}$' then
    raise exception 'Malformed order lines.' using errcode = 'PT400', hint = 'invalid_order', detail = 'lines';
  end if;
  if (customer ->> 'phone') is null or (customer ->> 'phone') !~ '^\+923[0-9]{9}$' then
    raise exception 'Invalid phone.' using errcode = 'PT400', hint = 'invalid_order', detail = 'phone';
  end if;

  if jsonb_typeof(p_order -> 'referral_code') not in ('string', 'null')
    or char_length(p_order ->> 'referral_code') > 64 then
    raise exception 'Malformed referral code.' using errcode = 'PT400', hint = 'invalid_order', detail = 'referral_code';
  end if;
  referral_code := private.normalize_referral_code(p_order ->> 'referral_code');
  if p_order ? 'discount_paisa' and jsonb_typeof(p_order -> 'discount_paisa') <> 'null' then
    if jsonb_typeof(p_order -> 'discount_paisa') <> 'number' or (p_order ->> 'discount_paisa') !~ '^[0-9]{1,12}$' then
      raise exception 'Malformed discount.' using errcode = 'PT400', hint = 'invalid_order', detail = 'discount';
    end if;
    discount := (p_order ->> 'discount_paisa')::bigint;
  end if;
  if referral_code is null and coalesce(discount, 0) <> 0 then
    raise exception 'A discount needs a referral code.' using errcode = 'PT400', hint = 'invalid_order', detail = 'discount';
  end if;

  select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
           'sku', l ->> 'sku', 'quantity', (l ->> 'quantity')::integer,
           'unit_price_paisa', (l ->> 'unit_price_paisa')::integer) order by l ->> 'sku')
  into lines
  from jsonb_array_elements(p_order -> 'lines') l;

  result := jsonb_build_object(
    'lines', lines,
    'delivery_paisa', (p_order ->> 'delivery_paisa')::bigint,
    'total_paisa', (p_order ->> 'total_paisa')::bigint,
    'customer', jsonb_build_object(
      'name', private.clean_text(customer ->> 'name', 2, 80, 'name'),
      'phone', customer ->> 'phone',
      'city', private.clean_text(customer ->> 'city', 2, 60, 'city'),
      'address', private.clean_text(customer ->> 'address', 10, 300, 'address'),
      'landmark', private.clean_text(customer ->> 'landmark', 0, 100, 'landmark'),
      'note', private.clean_text(customer ->> 'note', 0, 200, 'note')
    )
  );
  if referral_code is not null then
    result := result || jsonb_build_object('referral_code', referral_code, 'discount_paisa', coalesce(discount, 0));
  end if;

end;

-- Replaced (one more argument): the old four-argument version would make
-- calls with four arguments ambiguous.
drop function private.checkout_quote(jsonb, text, public.shop_settings, boolean);

-- As in 20261117120100, plus the referral code. New fields:
--   lines[].referral_eligible  true/false while a code applies, else null
--   lines[].discount_paisa     the line's share of the discount
--   discount_paisa, merchandise_paisa (subtotal - discount)
--   referral  null without a code, else {code, status, discount_bp,
--             applies_to_sale_items}; status is ok | invalid (no such code,
--             or malformed) | disabled | no_eligible_items. Nothing about
--             the agent, and no commission.
-- total = subtotal - discount + delivery; free delivery is judged on
-- merchandise_paisa. "exact" also needs the code (if any) to apply.
create function private.checkout_quote(
  p_lines jsonb, p_city text, p_settings public.shop_settings, p_online boolean default true, p_referral_code text default null
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  raw_lines jsonb;
  result_lines jsonb;
  subtotal bigint;
  buyable integer;
  delivery_status text;
  delivery bigint := 0;
  city_row public.delivery_cities;
  city_name text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_city, '')), '');
  v_code text := left(private.normalize_referral_code(p_referral_code), 32);
  agent public.sales_agents;
  referral jsonb;
  referral_ok boolean := false;
  eligible_total bigint := 0;
  discount bigint := 0;
  shares bigint[];
begin
  with requested as (
    select l ->> 'sku' as sku, (l ->> 'quantity')::integer as quantity, (l ->> 'unit_price_paisa')::integer as seen_price, n
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_lines) with ordinality as x (l, n)
  ),
  live as (
    select r.*, x.variant_id, x.size_eu, x.name, x.brand, x.item_status, x.condition, x.price_paisa, x.regular_price_paisa,
      x.on_sale,
      case
        when x.variant_id is null then 0
        else x.stock + coalesce((
          select sum(oi.quantity)::integer from public.order_items oi
          join public.orders o on o.id = oi.order_id
          where oi.variant_id = x.variant_id and o.status = 'awaiting_confirmation' and o.hold_expires_at <= now()
        ), 0)
      end as available,
      x.variant_id is null as gone
    from requested r
    left join lateral (
      select v.id as variant_id, v.size_eu, v.stock, p.name, p.brand, p.item_status, p.condition,
        coalesce(p.sale_price_paisa, p.price_paisa) as price_paisa, p.price_paisa as regular_price_paisa,
        p.sale_price_paisa is not null as on_sale
      from public.product_variants v
      join public.products p on p.id = v.product_id
      where v.sku = r.sku and (not p_online or p.publication_status = 'published')
    ) x on true
  ),
  judged as (
    select l.*,
      least(l.quantity, l.available, coalesce(case when p_online then p_settings.max_units_per_line end, l.quantity)) as allowed
    from live l
  )
  select
    jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'sku', j.sku,
      'status', case when j.gone then 'unavailable' when j.available = 0 then 'sold_out'
                     when j.allowed < j.quantity then 'reduced' else 'ok' end,
      'name', j.name, 'brand', j.brand, 'size_eu', j.size_eu, 'item_status', j.item_status, 'condition', j.condition,
      'quantity', j.quantity, 'allowed_quantity', case when j.gone then 0 else j.allowed end,
      'available', j.available,
      'unit_price_paisa', j.price_paisa,
      'regular_price_paisa', j.regular_price_paisa,
      'price_changed', not j.gone and j.price_paisa is distinct from j.seen_price,
      'seen_price_paisa', j.seen_price,
      -- Internal, removed below.
      '_total', case when not j.gone and j.allowed > 0 then j.allowed::bigint * j.price_paisa else 0 end,
      '_on_sale', coalesce(j.on_sale, false)
    ) order by j.n),
    coalesce(sum(j.allowed::bigint * j.price_paisa) filter (where not j.gone and j.allowed > 0), 0),
    count(*) filter (where not j.gone and j.allowed > 0)
  into raw_lines, subtotal, buyable
  from judged j;
  raw_lines := coalesce(raw_lines, '[]'::jsonb);

  -- The referral code, if any.
  if v_code is not null then
    if private.is_referral_code(v_code) then
      select * into agent from public.sales_agents a where a.code = v_code;
    end if;
    if agent.id is null then
      referral := jsonb_build_object('code', v_code, 'status', 'invalid');
    elsif not agent.code_enabled then
      referral := jsonb_build_object('code', v_code, 'status', 'disabled');
    else
      select coalesce(sum((l ->> '_total')::bigint), 0) into eligible_total
      from jsonb_array_elements(raw_lines) l
      where agent.applies_to_sale_items or not (l ->> '_on_sale')::boolean;
      referral := jsonb_build_object('code', v_code,
        'status', case when eligible_total > 0 then 'ok' else 'no_eligible_items' end,
        'discount_bp', agent.discount_bp, 'applies_to_sale_items', agent.applies_to_sale_items);
      if eligible_total > 0 then
        referral_ok := true;
        discount := private.percent_of(eligible_total, agent.discount_bp);
        select private.allocate_paisa(discount, array_agg(
                 case when agent.applies_to_sale_items or not (l ->> '_on_sale')::boolean then (l ->> '_total')::bigint else 0 end
                 order by i))
        into shares
        from jsonb_array_elements(raw_lines) with ordinality as e (l, i);
      end if;
    end if;
  end if;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    (l - '_total' - '_on_sale') || jsonb_build_object(
      'referral_eligible', case when referral_ok then agent.applies_to_sale_items or not (l ->> '_on_sale')::boolean end,
      'discount_paisa', case when referral_ok then shares[i] else 0 end)
    order by i), '[]'::jsonb)
  into result_lines
  from jsonb_array_elements(raw_lines) with ordinality as e (l, i);

  if p_settings.delivery_area_mode is null or p_settings.standard_delivery_fee_paisa is null
    or p_settings.free_delivery_enabled is null then
    delivery_status := 'not_configured';
  elsif city_name is null then
    delivery_status := 'city_required';
  else
    select * into city_row from public.delivery_cities c where c.city_key = lower(city_name) and c.active;
    if p_settings.delivery_area_mode = 'selected' and city_row.city is null then
      delivery_status := 'not_served';
    else
      delivery_status := 'ok';
      delivery := coalesce(city_row.fee_paisa, p_settings.standard_delivery_fee_paisa);
      -- Free delivery: judged on what the customer pays for the goods, after the discount.
      if buyable = 0 or (p_settings.free_delivery_enabled and subtotal - discount >= p_settings.free_delivery_min_paisa) then
        delivery := 0;
      end if;
    end if;
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'lines', result_lines,
    'subtotal_paisa', subtotal,
    'discount_paisa', discount,
    'merchandise_paisa', subtotal - discount,
    'referral', referral,
    'delivery_status', delivery_status,
    'delivery_paisa', delivery,
    'total_paisa', subtotal - discount + delivery,
    'free_delivery_min_paisa', case when p_settings.free_delivery_enabled then p_settings.free_delivery_min_paisa end,
    'orders_open', p_settings.orders_open,
    'exact', delivery_status = 'ok' and (v_code is null or referral_ok) and not exists (
      select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(result_lines) l
      where l ->> 'status' <> 'ok' or (l ->> 'price_changed')::boolean
    )
  );
end;
$$;

-- Saves the referral snapshot of a new order (called by place_cod_order
-- with everything locked, after the order's items are inserted).
create function private.record_order_referral(p_order_id uuid, p_agent public.sales_agents, p_quote jsonb)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  eligible_total bigint;
  discount_total bigint;
  discount bigint := (p_quote ->> 'discount_paisa')::bigint;
  nets bigint[];
  commission bigint;
  commission_shares bigint[];
begin
  -- Per line, from the order's own items (line_no = the quote line's position).
  select coalesce(sum(oi.line_total_paisa) filter (where (q.l ->> 'referral_eligible')::boolean), 0),
         coalesce(sum((q.l ->> 'discount_paisa')::bigint), 0),
         array_agg(case when (q.l ->> 'referral_eligible')::boolean
                        then oi.line_total_paisa - (q.l ->> 'discount_paisa')::bigint else 0 end order by oi.line_no)
  into eligible_total, discount_total, nets
  from public.order_items oi
  join jsonb_array_elements(p_quote -> 'lines') with ordinality as q (l, n) on q.n = oi.line_no
  where oi.order_id = p_order_id;
  if eligible_total <= 0 or discount_total <> discount then
    raise exception 'Referral amounts don''t add up.' using errcode = 'XX000';
  end if;

  commission := private.percent_of(eligible_total - discount, p_agent.commission_bp);
  commission_shares := private.allocate_paisa(commission, nets);

  insert into public.order_referrals (order_id, agent_id, code, agent_username, terms_version, discount_bp, commission_bp,
    applies_to_sale_items, eligible_subtotal_paisa, discount_paisa, commission_basis_paisa, commission_paisa, hold_hours,
    rounding_rule)
  values (p_order_id, p_agent.id, p_agent.code, p_agent.username, p_agent.terms_version, p_agent.discount_bp,
    p_agent.commission_bp, p_agent.applies_to_sale_items, eligible_total, discount, eligible_total - discount, commission,
    private.commission_hold_hours(), 'half_up_per_order_then_largest_remainder_per_line');

  insert into public.order_line_referrals (order_item_id, order_id, line_no, eligible, line_total_paisa, discount_paisa, commission_paisa)
  select oi.id, p_order_id, oi.line_no, (q.l ->> 'referral_eligible')::boolean, oi.line_total_paisa,
    (q.l ->> 'discount_paisa')::bigint, commission_shares[oi.line_no]
  from public.order_items oi
  join jsonb_array_elements(p_quote -> 'lines') with ordinality as q (l, n) on q.n = oi.line_no
  where oi.order_id = p_order_id;
end;
$$;

-- As in 20261117120100, plus the referral code (2a: its agent row is locked
-- FOR SHARE before the quote, so its terms are the ones saved). The discount
-- the customer saw must equal the database's, like the delivery fee and
-- total; otherwise quote_changed. New result: none (the existing results
-- cover a code that no longer applies: quote_changed, with the reason in
-- quote.referral.status).
create or replace function public.place_cod_order(p_gateway_key text, p_request_key text, p_order jsonb)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
set lock_timeout = '2s'
as $$
declare
  normalised jsonb;
  fingerprint bytea;
  request_hash bytea;
  existing public.orders;
  s public.shop_settings;
  variant_ids uuid[];
  expired uuid[];
  expired_id uuid;
  quote jsonb;
  new_order public.orders;
  item public.order_items;
  total_units integer;
  v_code text;
  agent public.sales_agents;
begin
  perform private.require_gateway(p_gateway_key);
  request_hash := private.checkout_key_hash(p_request_key);
  normalised := private.checkout_input(p_order);
  fingerprint := private.fingerprint(normalised);
  v_code := normalised ->> 'referral_code';

  -- 1. The key.
  perform private.lock_key(request_hash);
  select * into existing from public.orders o where o.request_key_hash = request_hash;
  if found then
    if existing.channel = 'online' and existing.request_fingerprint = fingerprint then
      return jsonb_build_object('result', 'existing', 'order', private.customer_order_view(existing.id));
    end if;
    return jsonb_build_object('result', 'mismatch');
  end if;
  if exists (select 1 from private.checkout_abandoned_keys a where a.key_hash = request_hash) then
    return jsonb_build_object('result', 'abandoned');
  end if;

  -- 1a. The phone number: one placement at a time per phone, until commit.
  perform private.lock_phone(normalised -> 'customer' ->> 'phone');

  -- 2. Settings (shared: a settings change waits for orders in progress).
  select * into s from public.shop_settings for share;
  if not s.orders_open then
    return jsonb_build_object('result', 'closed');
  end if;
  select sum((l ->> 'quantity')::integer) into total_units from jsonb_array_elements(normalised -> 'lines') l;
  if jsonb_array_length(normalised -> 'lines') > s.max_lines_per_order or total_units > s.max_units_per_order
    or exists (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(normalised -> 'lines') l where (l ->> 'quantity')::integer > s.max_units_per_line) then
    return jsonb_build_object('result', 'limits', 'max_lines', s.max_lines_per_order,
      'max_units', s.max_units_per_order, 'max_units_per_line', s.max_units_per_line);
  end if;
  if (select count(*) from public.orders o
      where o.status = 'awaiting_confirmation' and o.hold_expires_at > now()
        and o.customer_phone = normalised -> 'customer' ->> 'phone') >= s.max_open_orders_per_phone then
    return jsonb_build_object('result', 'phone_limit');
  end if;

  -- 2a. The code's agent: its terms stay as they are until this order commits.
  if v_code is not null and private.is_referral_code(v_code) then
    select * into agent from public.sales_agents a where a.code = v_code for share;
  end if;

  -- 3-5. Expired orders on these sizes, then products and sizes.
  select coalesce(array_agg(v.id), '{}') into variant_ids
  from public.product_variants v
  where v.sku in (select l ->> 'sku' from jsonb_array_elements(normalised -> 'lines') l);
  expired := private.lock_for_sale(variant_ids);
  foreach expired_id in array expired loop
    perform private.release_order(expired_id, true, 'system', null, null, 'hold_expired', null);
  end loop;

  -- Everything is locked: this quote is what the order will be.
  quote := private.checkout_quote(normalised -> 'lines', normalised -> 'customer' ->> 'city', s, true, v_code);
  if not (quote ->> 'exact')::boolean
    or (quote ->> 'delivery_paisa')::bigint <> (normalised ->> 'delivery_paisa')::bigint
    or (quote ->> 'discount_paisa')::bigint <> coalesce((normalised ->> 'discount_paisa')::bigint, 0)
    or (quote ->> 'total_paisa')::bigint <> (normalised ->> 'total_paisa')::bigint then
    return jsonb_build_object('result', 'quote_changed', 'quote', quote);
  end if;

  -- 6. The shop-wide quota: one slot per new order, taken last.
  if not private.take_quota_slot('place:1m:global', interval '1 minute', s.orders_per_minute_global) then
    return jsonb_build_object('result', 'busy');
  end if;

  insert into public.orders (
    order_number, channel, status, payment_status, request_key_hash, request_fingerprint,
    customer_name, customer_phone, city, address, landmark, delivery_note,
    subtotal_paisa, discount_paisa, delivery_paisa, total_paisa, hold_expires_at
  )
  values (
    'KO-' || nextval('public.order_number_seq'), 'online', 'awaiting_confirmation', 'pending', request_hash, fingerprint,
    normalised -> 'customer' ->> 'name', normalised -> 'customer' ->> 'phone', normalised -> 'customer' ->> 'city',
    normalised -> 'customer' ->> 'address', normalised -> 'customer' ->> 'landmark', normalised -> 'customer' ->> 'note',
    (quote ->> 'subtotal_paisa')::bigint, (quote ->> 'discount_paisa')::bigint, (quote ->> 'delivery_paisa')::bigint,
    (quote ->> 'total_paisa')::bigint, now() + make_interval(mins => s.hold_minutes)
  )
  returning * into new_order;

  perform private.insert_order_items(new_order.id, normalised -> 'lines');
  for item in select * from public.order_items where order_id = new_order.id order by variant_id loop
    perform private.inventory_apply(item.variant_id, -item.quantity, item.quantity, 'order_reserve',
      'reserve:' || item.id, new_order.id, item.id);
  end loop;

  if v_code is not null then
    perform private.record_order_referral(new_order.id, agent, quote);
  end if;

  insert into public.order_events (order_id, kind, to_status, to_payment, actor)
  values (new_order.id, 'placed', 'awaiting_confirmation', 'pending', 'customer');

  return jsonb_build_object('result', 'placed', 'order', private.customer_order_view(new_order.id));
end;
$$;

-- Source: 20261118120200_commission_accounting.sql
-- Commission lifecycle, adjustments and manually recorded payouts.
--
-- Builds on 20261118120100_referral_checkout.sql. Every referral order has
-- one fixed commission (public.order_referrals, per line in
-- public.order_line_referrals). Its state is NOT stored: it is worked out
-- whenever it is read or paid, from the order and the payout records, so a
-- repeated event, a status retry or a re-run can never move it twice.
--
-- States (private.commission_rows), in this order of precedence:
--   cancelled          order cancelled: earns nothing
--   reversed           order returned (the whole parcel; partial returns
--                      don't exist yet): the returned lines' commission is
--                      reversed, worked out per line from the return lines,
--                      which for a whole parcel is all of it
--   awaiting_delivery  placed, confirmed, dispatched or a failed delivery
--                      being retried: an estimate
--   paid               included in a payout
--   no_commission      delivered, but the commission is zero (e.g. a 0%
--                      rate): nothing to pay, never offered for payout
--   on_hold            delivered, and an admin has put the commission on
--                      hold (e.g. a return is being arranged); see below
--   held               delivered, less than hold_hours (720 = 30 x 24 hours,
--                      saved on the order) since the RECORDED delivery time
--                      (orders.delivered_at, fixed once set). Release time =
--                      delivered_at + hold_hours, an absolute instant (UTC in
--                      the database, shown in Pakistan time). Available from
--                      that instant exactly (>=), on the database's clock.
--   awaiting_payment   hold over, but the courier hasn't paid the shop yet
--                      (payment_status pending or collected; it must be
--                      "settled")
--   available          hold over and payment settled: can be paid out
--
-- What blocks availability: the 30-day hold, any payment status other than
-- "settled", and an admin's commission hold. The order model has no "return
-- requested" state: a return is recorded when the parcel is back
-- (delivered -> returned), which makes the commission "reversed" at once.
--
-- Commission holds (admin_set_commission_hold): an admin can hold one order's
-- commission while a return is being arranged, with a reason; and release it,
-- with a reason. Every hold and release is kept (who, when, why). A hold
-- changes nothing about the order, its payment or its saved terms; releasing
-- it only removes that one block, so the 30-day hold and settled payment are
-- still required. Holding and paying the same order run one after the other
-- (both lock the order row): hold first, the payout refuses it; payout first,
-- the hold is refused (already paid).
--
-- Returns after a payout: the commission stays paid (the payout is history)
-- and a negative adjustment of the paid amount is recorded automatically
-- (trigger on orders). Outstanding adjustments count against the next payout.
--
-- Payouts (admin_record_agent_payout) are recorded by an admin after paying
-- the agent outside the app. In one transaction the database checks that
-- every selected commission is "available" and unpaid, that every
-- outstanding negative adjustment is included, and that the amount equals
-- the selection's total (more than zero). A request id makes retries safe.
--
-- Locking: a payout locks the agent row FOR NO KEY UPDATE (one payout per
-- agent at a time), then its orders FOR SHARE in id order. A return locks
-- its order FOR UPDATE and never the agent row (its adjustment's foreign key
-- takes only KEY SHARE, which NO KEY UPDATE doesn't block). So a return and
-- a payout of the same order run one after the other: return first, the
-- payout refuses that commission; payout first, the return records the
-- adjustment.

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Tables
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

create table public.agent_adjustments (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  agent_id uuid not null references public.sales_agents (id) on delete restrict,
  -- return_after_payout: automatic, for an order whose paid commission was reversed.
  -- manual: an admin's correction, with a reason.
  kind text not null,
  order_id uuid references public.order_referrals (order_id) on delete restrict,
  amount_paisa bigint not null,
  reason text not null,
  details jsonb,
  request_id uuid,
  created_by uuid,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),

  constraint agent_adjustments_request_key unique (request_id),
  constraint agent_adjustments_kind_valid check (kind in ('return_after_payout', 'manual')),
  constraint agent_adjustments_amount_valid check (amount_paisa <> 0 and abs(amount_paisa) <= 100000000000),
  constraint agent_adjustments_reason_valid check (char_length(reason) between 5 and 300 and reason !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'),
  constraint agent_adjustments_kind_shape check (
    (kind = 'return_after_payout' and order_id is not null and amount_paisa < 0 and request_id is null)
    or (kind = 'manual' and request_id is not null))
);

create unique index agent_adjustments_one_reversal_per_order on public.agent_adjustments (order_id)
  where kind = 'return_after_payout';
create index agent_adjustments_agent_idx on public.agent_adjustments (agent_id, created_at desc);

create table public.agent_payouts (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  agent_id uuid not null references public.sales_agents (id) on delete restrict,
  request_id uuid not null,
  -- SHA-256 of the request (agent, selection, amount, date, method,
  -- reference): the same request id with anything different is refused.
  request_fingerprint bytea not null,
  amount_paisa bigint not null,
  paid_on date not null,
  method text not null,
  reference text,
  note text,
  created_by uuid,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),

  constraint agent_payouts_request_key unique (request_id),
  constraint agent_payouts_amount_positive check (amount_paisa > 0),
  constraint agent_payouts_method_valid check (method in ('cash', 'bank_transfer', 'easypaisa', 'jazzcash', 'other')),
  constraint agent_payouts_reference_valid check (reference is null or (char_length(reference) between 1 and 100 and reference !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')),
  constraint agent_payouts_note_valid check (note is null or (char_length(note) between 1 and 500 and note !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'))
);

create index agent_payouts_agent_idx on public.agent_payouts (agent_id, paid_on desc, created_at desc);

-- What each payout paid: commissions (by order) and adjustments. Each is
-- paid at most once (unique), whatever happens concurrently.
create table public.agent_payout_lines (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  payout_id uuid not null references public.agent_payouts (id) on delete restrict,
  agent_id uuid not null references public.sales_agents (id) on delete restrict,
  order_id uuid references public.order_referrals (order_id) on delete restrict,
  adjustment_id uuid references public.agent_adjustments (id) on delete restrict,
  amount_paisa bigint not null,

  constraint agent_payout_lines_order_key unique (order_id),
  constraint agent_payout_lines_adjustment_key unique (adjustment_id),
  constraint agent_payout_lines_one_thing check ((order_id is null) <> (adjustment_id is null)),
  constraint agent_payout_lines_order_positive check (order_id is null or amount_paisa > 0)
);

create index agent_payout_lines_payout_idx on public.agent_payout_lines (payout_id);

-- Admin holds on single commissions: every hold and release, never changed.
-- The latest event for an order says whether it is on hold.
create table public.commission_hold_events (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  order_id uuid not null references public.order_referrals (order_id) on delete restrict,
  agent_id uuid not null references public.sales_agents (id) on delete restrict,
  action text not null,
  reason text not null,
  request_id uuid not null,
  -- SHA-256 of {order, action, reason}: the same request id with anything else is refused.
  request_fingerprint bytea not null,
  actor_user_id uuid,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),

  constraint commission_hold_events_request_key unique (request_id),
  constraint commission_hold_events_action_valid check (action in ('hold', 'release')),
  constraint commission_hold_events_reason_valid check (char_length(reason) between 5 and 300 and reason !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'),
  constraint commission_hold_events_fingerprint_length check (octet_length(request_fingerprint) = 32)
);

create index commission_hold_events_order_idx on public.commission_hold_events (order_id, id desc);

create trigger commission_hold_events_append_only before update or delete on public.commission_hold_events
  for each row execute function private.append_only();
create trigger commission_hold_events_no_truncate before truncate on public.commission_hold_events
  for each statement execute function private.append_only();

create trigger agent_adjustments_append_only before update or delete on public.agent_adjustments
  for each row execute function private.append_only();
create trigger agent_adjustments_no_truncate before truncate on public.agent_adjustments
  for each statement execute function private.append_only();
create trigger agent_payouts_append_only before update or delete on public.agent_payouts
  for each row execute function private.append_only();
create trigger agent_payouts_no_truncate before truncate on public.agent_payouts
  for each statement execute function private.append_only();
create trigger agent_payout_lines_append_only before update or delete on public.agent_payout_lines
  for each row execute function private.append_only();
create trigger agent_payout_lines_no_truncate before truncate on public.agent_payout_lines
  for each statement execute function private.append_only();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Commission states (derived)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- The commission reversed by an order's returns, line by line: a line's
-- commission times the share of its pairs that came back (all of them, for
-- the whole-parcel returns that exist today), rounded down.
create function private.commission_reversed(p_order_id uuid)
returns bigint
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select coalesce(sum(
    case when back.quantity >= oi.quantity then lr.commission_paisa
         else floor(lr.commission_paisa::numeric * back.quantity / oi.quantity)::bigint end), 0)::bigint
  from public.order_line_referrals lr
  join public.order_items oi on oi.id = lr.order_item_id
  join lateral (
    select coalesce(sum(rl.quantity), 0) as quantity from public.order_return_lines rl where rl.order_item_id = oi.id
  ) back on true
  where lr.order_id = p_order_id;
$$;

-- Every commission of one agent (or of all agents, p_agent_id null) with its
-- state as of now().
create function private.commission_rows(p_agent_id uuid)
returns table (
  order_id uuid, agent_id uuid, order_number text, placed_at timestamptz, order_status text, payment_status text,
  delivered_at timestamptz, release_at timestamptz, code text, terms_version integer, discount_bp integer,
  commission_bp integer, applies_to_sale_items boolean, eligible_subtotal_paisa bigint, discount_paisa bigint,
  commission_basis_paisa bigint, commission_paisa bigint, reversed_paisa bigint, earned_paisa bigint,
  state text, payout_id uuid, paid_paisa bigint, on_hold boolean, hold_reason text
)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select r.order_id, r.agent_id, o.order_number, o.created_at, o.status, o.payment_status,
    o.delivered_at, o.delivered_at + make_interval(hours => r.hold_hours), r.code, r.terms_version, r.discount_bp,
    r.commission_bp, r.applies_to_sale_items, r.eligible_subtotal_paisa, r.discount_paisa,
    r.commission_basis_paisa, r.commission_paisa, x.reversed, r.commission_paisa - x.reversed,
    case
      when o.status = 'cancelled' then 'cancelled'
      when o.status = 'returned' then 'reversed'
      when o.status in ('awaiting_confirmation', 'confirmed', 'dispatched', 'delivery_failed') then 'awaiting_delivery'
      when pl.order_id is not null then 'paid'
      when r.commission_paisa = 0 then 'no_commission'
      when h.action = 'hold' then 'on_hold'
      when o.status = 'delivered' and now() < o.delivered_at + make_interval(hours => r.hold_hours) then 'held'
      when o.status = 'delivered' and o.payment_status <> 'settled' then 'awaiting_payment'
      when o.status = 'delivered' then 'available'
      else 'unknown'
    end,
    pl.payout_id, pl.amount_paisa, coalesce(h.action = 'hold', false), case when h.action = 'hold' then h.reason end
  from public.order_referrals r
  join public.orders o on o.id = r.order_id
  left join public.agent_payout_lines pl on pl.order_id = r.order_id
  left join lateral (
    select e.action, e.reason from public.commission_hold_events e where e.order_id = r.order_id order by e.id desc limit 1
  ) h on true
  cross join lateral (
    select case when o.status = 'cancelled' then r.commission_paisa
                when o.status = 'returned' then private.commission_reversed(r.order_id)
                else 0 end as reversed
  ) x
  where p_agent_id is null or r.agent_id = p_agent_id;
$$;

-- Totals for one agent.
create function private.agent_totals(p_agent_id uuid)
returns jsonb
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'referred_orders', count(*),
    'cancelled_orders', count(*) filter (where c.state = 'cancelled'),
    'returned_orders', count(*) filter (where c.state = 'reversed'),
    'awaiting_delivery_paisa', coalesce(sum(c.commission_paisa) filter (where c.state = 'awaiting_delivery'), 0),
    'held_paisa', coalesce(sum(c.commission_paisa) filter (where c.state = 'held'), 0),
    'awaiting_payment_paisa', coalesce(sum(c.commission_paisa) filter (where c.state = 'awaiting_payment'), 0),
    'available_paisa', coalesce(sum(c.commission_paisa) filter (where c.state = 'available'), 0),
    'on_hold_paisa', coalesce(sum(c.commission_paisa) filter (where c.state = 'on_hold'), 0),
    'reversed_paisa', coalesce(sum(c.reversed_paisa) filter (where c.state = 'reversed'), 0),
    'paid_paisa', (select coalesce(sum(p.amount_paisa), 0) from public.agent_payouts p where p.agent_id = p_agent_id),
    'outstanding_adjustments_paisa', (
      select coalesce(sum(a.amount_paisa), 0) from public.agent_adjustments a
      where a.agent_id = p_agent_id and not exists (select 1 from public.agent_payout_lines pl where pl.adjustment_id = a.id)),
    'next_release_at', min(c.release_at) filter (where c.state = 'held')
  ) || jsonb_build_object('payable_paisa',
    coalesce(sum(c.commission_paisa) filter (where c.state = 'available'), 0) + (
      select coalesce(sum(a.amount_paisa), 0) from public.agent_adjustments a
      where a.agent_id = p_agent_id and not exists (select 1 from public.agent_payout_lines pl where pl.adjustment_id = a.id)))
  from private.commission_rows(p_agent_id) c;
$$;

create function private.page_bounds(p_page integer, p_page_size integer)
returns integer[]
language plpgsql
immutable
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if p_page is null or p_page < 0 or p_page > 100000 or p_page_size is null or p_page_size not between 1 and 100 then
    raise exception 'Malformed page.' using errcode = 'PT400';
  end if;
  return array[p_page * p_page_size, p_page_size];
end;
$$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Returns after payout: the automatic adjustment
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

create function private.orders_commission_reversal()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  paid public.agent_payout_lines;
  reversed bigint;
begin
  select * into paid from public.agent_payout_lines pl where pl.order_id = new.id;
  if not found then
    return null;
  end if;
  reversed := least(paid.amount_paisa, private.commission_reversed(new.id));
  if reversed > 0 then
    insert into public.agent_adjustments (agent_id, kind, order_id, amount_paisa, reason, details)
    values (paid.agent_id, 'return_after_payout', new.id, -reversed,
      'Order ' || new.order_number || ' was returned after its commission was paid.',
      jsonb_build_object('payout_id', paid.payout_id, 'paid_paisa', paid.amount_paisa,
        'lines', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('line_no', lr.line_no, 'commission_paisa', lr.commission_paisa)
                                   order by lr.line_no)
                  from public.order_line_referrals lr where lr.order_id = new.id)))
    on conflict (order_id) where kind = 'return_after_payout' do nothing;
  end if;
  return null;
end;
$$;

create trigger orders_commission_reversal
  after update of status on public.orders
  for each row when (new.status = 'returned' and old.status is distinct from 'returned')
  execute function private.orders_commission_reversal();

stable

-- One agent: configuration, totals, what can be paid now, and the change log.
create function public.admin_get_agent(p_agent_id uuid)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  perform public.admin_require_catalogue_admin();
  if not exists (select 1 from public.sales_agents a where a.id = p_agent_id) then

  return private.agent_admin_view(p_agent_id) || jsonb_build_object(

      from public.agent_adjustments a
      where a.agent_id = p_agent_id and not exists (select 1 from public.agent_payout_lines pl where pl.adjustment_id = a.id)),

      from (select * from public.sales_agent_events e where e.agent_id = p_agent_id order by e.id desc limit 50) e),

-- An agent's payouts (with what each paid) and all adjustments, newest first.
create function public.admin_agent_payouts(p_agent_id uuid, p_page integer, p_page_size integer)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  bounds integer[] := private.page_bounds(p_page, p_page_size);
begin
  perform public.admin_require_catalogue_admin();
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'total', (select count(*) from public.agent_payouts p where p.agent_id = p_agent_id),

                  from public.agent_payout_lines pl left join public.orders o on o.id = pl.order_id
                  where pl.payout_id = p.id))

      from (select * from public.agent_payouts p2 where p2.agent_id = p_agent_id
            order by p2.paid_on desc, p2.created_at desc offset bounds[1] limit bounds[2]) p), '[]'::jsonb),

        'payout_id', (select pl.payout_id from public.agent_payout_lines pl where pl.adjustment_id = a.id))
        order by a.created_at desc)
      from public.agent_adjustments a left join public.orders o on o.id = a.order_id

-- The referral saved on one order, for the admin order page. Null if none.
create function public.admin_order_referral(p_order_id uuid)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  perform public.admin_require_catalogue_admin();
  return (
    select to_jsonb(c) || jsonb_build_object(
      'agent_username_now', a.username, 'agent_display_name', a.display_name, 'agent_username_then', r.agent_username,
      'hold_hours', r.hold_hours, 'rounding_rule', r.rounding_rule,

                       from public.commission_hold_events e where e.order_id = r.order_id),
